insight: Went viral at its June 2024 launch, hitting 1M users in four days with no marketing; Luma later raised a $900M Series C.
name: Luma Dream Machine
tagline: Mobile-first AI video generation from text and images.
description: Luma Labs' video model surfaced as an iOS app and web tool. Strong text-to-video, image-to-video, and keyframe controls — the indie creator's go-to before reaching for Runway's heavier toolkit.
edge: Fast, mobile-first text/image-to-video with keyframe controls — the speed pick for many quick variations.
pros: Free tier to try it out
